name: Suki★Yaki♥Okami
source:
This is a visual novel made by Domino's Pizza Japan. 

In the game, the stern 52-year-old proprietress of a sukiyaki shop in Kyoto and a 25-year-old employee of the shop finish their work after a long day. It's late and the worker considers going home. But if he stays and helps the woman clean up the restaurant, he may be able to gain her praise. Could impressing the great hostess help the young worker move toward his dream of owning his own shop one day?

Players are tasked with successfully wooing the owner of a sukiyaki restaurant. If players manage not to infuriate her, they win a 50% off coupon for a large "sukiyaking" pizza. Players have to choose the proper option to impress the woman several times in order to receive the coupon. 

[From [url=http://www.animenewsnetwork.com/interest/2017-11-01/domino-japan-introduces-visual-novel-about-sukiyaki/.123442]Anime News Network[/url]]
translation:
这是一款由日本必胜客制作的视觉小说。

游戏中，京都一家寿喜烧店里严厉的52岁女老板和25岁的店员结束了漫长的一天工作。天色已晚，店员正考虑回家。但如果他留下来帮助女老板收拾餐厅，也许就能得到她的表扬。给这位了不起的女老板留下好印象，能帮助年轻店员朝着将来拥有自己的店铺这一梦想前进吗？

玩家的任务是成功追求寿喜烧店老板。如果玩家设法不惹她生气，就能获得一张大份“寿喜王”披萨的五折优惠券。玩家必须多次选择恰当选项来打动女老板，才能得到优惠券。

[来源：[url=http://www.animenewsnetwork.com/interest/2017-11-01/domino-japan-introduces-visual-novel-about-sukiyaki/.123442]Anime News Network[/url]]
